response.justification: Technically this candidate far exceeds the bar: 15+ years of fullstack work with TypeScript/Node.js, React, REST APIs, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS CDK, and recent AI-agent/LLM tooling experience, all of which maps cleanly onto the stack and the nice-to-haves. The concern is fit rather than capability — the role is explicitly entry-level individual contributor, and hiring a Staff-level engineer with founder experience creates real risks around compensation expectations, motivation, and retention. Relational database depth is also lightly evidenced (mostly MongoDB/MySQL, no PostgreSQL or Nest.js), and only basic German could matter for an on-site German energy-consulting/construction domain. Worth a screening call to test genuine interest in a junior-scoped role, or to consider for a more senior opening.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js and React fullstack experience across many production systems
Strong on nice-to-haves: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, LLM/AI-agent tooling
Proven craftsmanship culture — TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, open-source and public talks
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an explicitly entry-level role; likely salary and scope mismatch
No demonstrated PostgreSQL or Nest.js; database work is mainly MongoDB/MySQL
Only basic German for a high on-site role in German energy/construction consulting
